name: Lepu Medical Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd.
summary: Lepu Medical Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, and manufacturing of cardiac interventional medical devices in China and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Medical Devices; Pharmaceuticals; and Medical Services and Health Management.
